newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Air matches companion fares.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Air matches companion fares.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Friday it is matching a companion sale offered by Southwest Airlines Co.
The sale provides a free companion ticket when one ticket is purchased at a walk-up fare level.
The non-refundable companion sale fares require a three day advance purchase. Round trip travel and either a one night or Saturday night stay is required. Other restrictions apply.
Tickets must be purchased no late than May 20, 1997 and all travel must be completed by July 22, 1997.
